citations.narrative:
The program of veterinary care doesn't have a deworming schedule for his puppies that has been prepared and approved
of by the attending veterinarian. Not having a deworming schedule in the program of veterinary care doesn't ensure the
puppies are being adequately dewormed against the various parasites that can infect a dog. The attending veterinarian
must add a deworming schedule to the program of veterinary care for the puppies.

The licensee had annual exams completed on all the adult dogs in the spring of 2026. Approximately 20 adult dogs were
documented as needing dentals (teeth cleaning) done. The licensee has performed the dentals, but has not documented
when these dentals were completed. Not documenting all treatment procedures performed on all dogs doesn't allow
APHIS officials to confirm these treatment procedures have been completed. The licensee must document all treatment
procedures on all dogs going forward. Correct starting on 6/12/26.

The licensee has sampled his population for fecal parasites within the past few months, but he discarded the
documentation of the test results. Not keeping all medical records for at least one year after the dog(s) has been
euthanized, transferred out, or otherwise disposed of doesn't allow APHIS officials to ensure the population has been
sampled for parasites in accordance with a schedule approved by the attending veterinarian. The licensee must keep all
medical records for all dogs for at least one year after the dog(s) has been euthanized, transferred out, or otherwise
disposed of. Correct starting on 6/12/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
